description: An interactive field guide to GPS: why a receiver needs four satellites (three for position, one for its own clock), how a microsecond of clock error becomes 300 metres, why satellite clocks are set to tick slow on the ground to cancel 38 microseconds a day of relativity, and how satellite geometry multiplies range errors.
og: Four satellites, one clock error, 38 µs a day of relativity: GPS positioning, interactive and checked against Ashby's relativity review.
brand: NAVIGATOR — TECHNICAL FIELD GUIDE / ТЕХНИЧЕСКИЙ СПРАВОЧНИК
